THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No. : VE/DS/AQ/R.D.A/164.Land Ministry Ref. No. : 4-3/7/2014/HW/312.
I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the LandAcquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the followinglands which are required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:

Lot No. 01 (Lot 01) allotments in total extent of about 0.0104Hectare of land in Preliminary Plan No. Ya: 2820 and dated 15.07.2015prepared by the Surveyor-Superintendent on behalf of Surveyor-Jaffna, General situated in the Village of Saravanai in theGramaniladhari Divisions Saravanai West, J/21 in the DivisionalSecretary’s Division of Island South (Velanai) in Jaffna District inthe Northern Province.
01. Lot No. 1Name of land: Kaddu Nochchikuli and Nochchikuli; Description:Garden; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: ArumugamPanchatcharam, Saravanai West, Velanai; Extent: 0.0104 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby requiredto appear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing, beforeme at Divisional Secretariat office of Island South (Velanai) on 27 thday of August, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notifyto me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 20th day of August,2015, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of theirclaims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, theamount of compensation and the details of the computation of suchamount.
MANCHULADEVI SATHEESAN,
Divisional Secretary,Divisional Secretariat,
Island South Velanai.
Divisional Secretary’s Office,Island South (Velanai).03rd August, 2015.
